name: Last Epoch Scanner
description: Runs le-scanner's actions (github.com/mike623/le-tool) from a button: scan the stash, import the character, equip the build in use, open the planner. Needs `le-scanner overlay` or `serve` running. On the phone, the Scan All Tabs button shows whatever le-scanner is running, and each other button its own action while it runs; character stats are the Last Epoch Character tiles.

options.label: Scan Open Tab
options.note: Pick which tab is open below.

options.label: Open Planner
options.note: Shows le-scanner's planner window (the browser with `le-scanner serve`).

note: Only Scan Open Tab uses Tab. On the phone, Scan All Tabs shows the progress of whatever le-scanner is running.
label: LE {action}
